## Goal
Make worker registration safe when two threads initialize the same named worker concurrently.

## Scope fence
- squatch/worker.py
- tests/test_worker.py

## Acceptance criteria
- A worker is fully initialized before it becomes visible in the shared registry.
- Concurrent registration of one name returns only fully initialized instances.

## Verification
```
uv run pytest tests/test_worker.py -q
```
